findings.summary: The observable error.reason for a cold cache changes shadow-trace-drift -> shadow-replay-cache-miss (not just the text). Recorded in ADR-0547:81-82 and the npm-client CHANGELOG and needed for the terminal mapping; ADR-0361:63/134 still read 'drifted trace stays shadow-trace-drift', which remains true (a cold cache is not drift) — no cross-reference from 0361 to the new reason.

The no-COI terminal unit carrier re-implements the toolchain owner's install hook in the test ('minus its stamp claim'); a divergence in the real owner hook would not be caught here. The real hook is covered by the packed Chromium proof (CI lane light 1/8), so advisory.

Exact-reinstall exit says 'restore those bytes to the tarball cache' without naming how a user does that; npm-client cannot name snapshot terms (layering) and READMEs (packages/rifty/README.md:204-207, packages/workbench/README.md:244-247) map it to replay snapshot / warm cache, so acceptable.
